$description: example-brand's imagery pool (0014-design-systems FR-043): one plain test drawing, so every design system that requires imagery can be proven under a second brand.

fields.id: stable slug, environment first and then the anchor; the master's file name without .png
fields.name: a short human name
fields.file: the master: <id>.png, the approved file byte for byte, with real transparency
fields.description: what is drawn, foreground to horizon
fields.visual_anchor: the one built thing the eye lands on
fields.route: how people move through the scene
fields.built_structures: every human-made thing in the scene
fields.infrastructure_type: the kind of system the structures form (bridge, railway, dam, observatory, ...)
fields.colored_elements: what carries color: human intervention, plus water when present
fields.metaphors: what the piece can stand for
fields.suggested_subjects: subjects the metaphors suit; a starting point, not a rule
fields.source: where the approved piece came from
fields.content_box: [left, top, right, bottom] pixel bounds of the drawn art (alpha > 16); a renderer that needs the art alone trims to it
fields.web: the master as WebP for the web, one file per width, each [file, width, height]; written by tools/brand_imagery.py build

pieces.name: Example Ridge Trail
pieces.description: Two gray ridges above a blue lake, a red trail climbing from the shore to a red hut.
pieces.visual_anchor: the hut at the trail's end
pieces.route: a trail from the lake shore up the near ridge
metaphors: a first route into new ground
